Introduction

Wang Zi Hao, known by the stage name LE'V, is a Chinese singer under Chromosome Entertainment. He made his solo debut on August 18, 2023, with the EP "A.I.BAE".

He is best known for being a contestant on the reality survival show “Boys Planet” where he finished in 19th place.
